verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs list current-generation B200, H100 and GH200 instances on On-Demand Cloud, and the pricing page adds the previous-generation A100 as a self-serve option alongside them. The core of the story is covered: picking between current and older datacenter GPUs. Missing for 10: any mention of H200, evidence that the previous-generation options are actually cheaper (no per-GPU price comparison), breadth of older GPU types beyond A100, and independent corroboration of real availability.
